sql:

FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.calls c1 ON s.symbol_id = c1.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.calls c2 ON s.symbol_id = c2.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f1 ON s.file_id = f1.file_id
JOIN code.files f2 ON s.file_id = f2.file_id
WHERE f1.module = 'termui'
  AND f2.module = 'utils'
  AND c1.callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'termui') AND name = 'style')
  AND c2.callee_symbol_id IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'utils') AND name = 'echo')
